info.title: Fatoura API
info.description: UAE VAT sales, purchases and invoicing.

ClientKind.description: Web clients receive the refresh token as an httpOnly cookie; mobile clients receive it in the body.

CurrencyDto.description: A foreign currency and its rate in AED per unit.

DocumentCurrencyDto.description: A document's currency, its rate (AED per unit) and its totals in AED, which reports and the VAT return use.

DocumentDiscountDto.description: The discount as entered, and `Amount`, its value in money. The sub total before discount is `SubTotal + Amount`.

DocumentDiscountRequest.description: A document-level discount: `Kind` Amount (AED) or Percent (of the sub total); omit or use None for no discount.

DocumentLineRequest.description: Validated by Task DocumentLines.ValidateAsync(IReadOnlyList<DocumentLineRequest>? lines, FatouraDbContext db, FieldValidator v, CancellationToken ct, bool allowInactiveItems = false) so all line errors are reported together.

ProfitLossDto.description: BRD §3.7: Profit = Sales − Purchases/costs, all excluding VAT.

PurchaseLineRequest.description: A purchase line: an item (adds stock at this unit cost) or an expense with a free-text category.

PurchaseReportRow.description: One purchase, in AED whatever its `Currency`.

RecentInvoiceDto.description: Total and balance are in the invoice's currency.

SalesReportRow.description: One sales document, in AED whatever its `Currency`; credit notes carry negative amounts so rows sum to net sales.

TermsRequest.description: Optional per-document terms; omitted values fall back to the defaults in Settings.

UpdateInvoiceRequest.description: Omitting the currency or rate keeps the invoice's own.

VatBox.description: A line of the FTA VAT 201 return.
